texts.text_span: Cindy’s peak intensity of 50 kt from 0600 UTC to 1800 UTC 24 June is based on a blend of Dvorak estimates from TAFB, SAB, and the ADT at 0600 and 1200 UTC that day. The satellite estimates ranged from 45 to 65 kt during that time period. Data from the Air Force Reserve Hurricane Hunters around 1800 UTC 24 June also supported the 50-kt intensity. The aircraft reported maximum 850-mb flight-level winds of 59 kt, which converts to 47 kt at the surface, and maximum SFMR winds of 48 kt at that same time. The minimum central pressure of 1004 mb is based on a blend of the Knaff-Zehr-Courtney pressure wind relationship and data collected by the Air Force Reserve Hurricane Hunters around 1800 UTC 24 June.
